parameters.body: ={"query":"query { me { user_books(where: { status_id: { _in: [1, 2, 3] }, updated_at: { _gt: \"{{ $json.lastChecked }}\" } }, order_by: { updated_at: asc }) { id updated_at rating status_id user_book_reads(order_by: { id: desc }, limit: 1) { finished_at } reading_journals(where: { event: { _in: [\"rated\", \"status_read\", \"finished\"] } }, order_by: { action_at: desc }, limit: 1) { action_at event } book { slug title image { url } contributions { author { name } } book_series(order_by: { position: asc }, limit: 1) { position series { name } } editions(limit: 1, order_by: { users_count: desc }) { isbn_13 isbn_10 image { url } } } } } }"}
